description: No reuse: every request prefills its whole prompt
Prefix cache in GPU memory with least-recently-used eviction (the usual default in serving stacks)
Evicted blocks move to host memory before being dropped
Evicted blocks cascade down HBM -> DRAM -> SSD -> HDD; a hit is promoted back to the GPU
Like all_tiers, but a block only goes below server memory once it has been reused; one-off context is dropped instead of written to disk
Nothing is ever evicted: the most reuse this trace allows. Not buildable; it is the yardstick
